title: ClearGlass SMB Cyber Trust Agent Tool Schema
description: Tool contract for the SMB Cyber Trust Agent. Every tool maps 1:1 to a pure function in bots.smb_cyber_trust_kit_bot so the browser console and the backend agent share one deterministic source of truth.

tools.name: score_risk
tools.description: Score one risk on the 5x5 heat-map. Returns score (1-25), band, colour, and recommended action.

tools.name: build_heat_map
tools.description: Return the 25-cell grid with the starter risk register placed on it.

tools.name: rank_risks
tools.description: Return the risk register scored and sorted worst-first — the owner's to-do order.

tools.name: render_policy
tools.description: Render one of the eight policy templates as plain Markdown, personalised to the business name.

tools.name: incident_script
tools.description: Return incident communication scripts for an audience, optionally filtered by phase. Regulator and media scripts require human approval before sending.

tools.name: translate_jargon
tools.description: Translate a technical term into plain language plus an everyday analogy.

tools.name: build_kit
tools.description: Assemble the entire kit (all four deliverables) personalised to a business name.

tools.name: handoff_to_clearglass
tools.description: Hand off to the ClearGlass team when the business wants implementation help beyond the templates. Produces a structured summary and a recommended offer; never sends anything without confirmation.
